faqs.q: What should I do if the client is not present at the site visit time?
faqs.a: Wait at the location and contact your assigned Hello Solar Field Coordinator immediately using the phone number in the job details modal. Do not begin work on roofs or electrical panels without homeowner or authorized site representative sign-in.

faqs.q: How do I request a schedule adjustment or weather postponement?
faqs.a: Due to strict safety protocols for rooftop rain or severe wind (>30 km/h), submit a support request choosing 'Site Access & Scheduling' or call dispatch directly. Weather delays will never penalize your installer performance rating.

faqs.q: When are milestone labor payouts released to my bank account?
faqs.a: Milestone payouts (30% Mounting / 50% Electrical & Inverter / 20% Handover) are audited within 24–48 hours of photo proof submission and released to your registered BDO account on regular disbursement cutoffs. Pending review status confirms photos are under review and does not indicate funds have been released.

faqs.q: Why is 2% Creditable Withholding Tax (CWT) deducted?
faqs.a: Under Philippine BIR tax regulations (RR 2-98), payments to registered contractors are subject to a 2% CWT deduction. Hello Solar issues your official BIR Form 2307 certificate quarterly, which you can claim as tax credits on your BIR Form 1701Q/1702Q filings.

faqs.q: What if delivered solar panels or inverters show transit damage?
faqs.a: Do NOT install damaged components. Take clear timestamped photos of the serial barcode, pallet packaging, and defect, then submit them directly to your coordinator. Replacement equipment will be dispatched from our nearest hub within 24 hours.

faqs.q: Who provides the PEE-stamped Single Line Diagram (SLD) and LGU electrical permits?
faqs.a: Hello Solar's engineering office provides approved, PEE-sealed SLDs and LGU Building/Electrical Permits before dispatch. Digital copies are linked in your job details, and physical stamped copies are in the equipment document pouch on site.

faqs.q: What are the mandatory PPE requirements for all rooftop installers?
faqs.a: Full-body fall arrest harness with twin shock-absorbing lanyards connected to certified lifelines, ANSI-certified hard hat, electrical safety boots (1000V rated), and UV eye protection. Zero tolerance applies to working without tied-off harnesses.

faqs.q: How do I update my contractor license or team coverage areas?
faqs.a: You can update your personal contact details, business information, and coverage areas anytime directly on the Profile page. For changes to PCAB licenses or PRC engineering numbers, save the updates on your Profile and submit your revised accreditation documents via Support for compliance verification.
It indicates that your license and registration details have been submitted and are recorded in the Hello Solar contractor directory, pending routine periodic compliance re-audit.

faqs.q: What steps are required to complete the final handover?
faqs.a: 1) Perform insulation and anti-islanding tests, 2) pair the inverter with the customer's Wi-Fi network, 3) guide the homeowner on the rapid shutdown procedure, and 4) have them sign the digital handover form on the mobile portal.

sop.rule: Verify Village/LGU Work Permit, confirm weather forecast, and inspect all safety fall arrest harnesses and ladders before departing base.
Locate structural rafters. Use torque wrenches for mid/end clamps (14 Nm spec). Seal all roof penetrations with outdoor-grade UV sealant and EPDM gaskets.
Maintain strict DC polarity. Run dedicated solar PV cable (4mm² or 6mm²) inside corrugated metal or heavy-duty uPVC conduits. Ground all panel frames with stainless steel star washers.
Measure string Voc and Isc before switching DC isolators ON. Confirm earth loop impedance < 5 Ohms. Verify AC grid sync voltage and frequency tolerances.
Affix high-voltage warning labels and emergency shutdown placards. Provide client orientation, complete photo package, and obtain sign-off.
